description: Count the people a Follow up message can reach now: people whose last message to the account was within 24 hours (Instagram's messaging window) and who have not had a follow-up since it. too_late counts people who wrote in the last 28 days but whose 24 hours have closed: nobody can message them. Pass automation_id for the people one automation reached, or all: true for everyone. People who replied STOP or asked for a person are left out. Sends nothing.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
